data.body:
Landed. PR #2: https://github.com/mrojas54/tool-benchmarks/pull/2 (base main, based on #1 — merge that first, this rebases onto origin/tb-2-scaffold @ dd96d91).

toolbench/sources.py implements SessionRef, iter_session_files (S7), iter_agentsview_sessions with cursor pagination (S8), open_session_jsonl (S9), and iter_sessions resolving the auto/agentsview/raw index-source policy with fallback-reason recording (S10). test_sources.py (S24) uses an injected fake subprocess-runner seam — 19 new tests, fully hermetic, no daemon or ~/.claude access.

Validation green: ruff clean, mypy --strict clean (8 source files), full unittest suite 26/26 passing.

Own-review: APPROVE, no Critical/Major findings. One Minor (non-blocking) noted: auto-mode issues a throwaway probe call before the real first-page listing — a deliberate tradeoff, flagged for awareness only.

Deviations: no SPEC/plan deviations. New footgun beyond TB-2's list: this install's 'lattice attach --role' only accepts 'review', not 'validation' — worked around with '--type note --title Validation' for the validation artifact.

toolbench/__init__.py untouched (avoided the flagged shared-file collision with TB-3).

Status: review. Stopping here — not merging, not touching other tickets.

PR #2 (tb-4-sources) merged to main as 7aada7e at 2026-07-09T01:00:47Z. sources.py multi-agent discovery landed. Verified on origin/main @4461c0e: ruff clean, mypy --strict clean (10 source files), 99 tests pass. Remote branch pruned post-merge.
